headline: Sequence and signal models for RNA therapeutic design and RNA measurement
label: Sequence Based Rna Modeling
summary: Deep learning and benchmarking methods now target RNA design and measurement directly from sequence, raw current, and mass spectra.
synthesis: The common thread is computational inference on RNA molecules directly from sequence, raw signal, or spectra, aimed at either therapeutic design or molecular measurement. DeepRNAi predicts on- and off-target siRNA knockdown from siRNA and mRNA sequence and releases a training and benchmark dataset. A translation efficiency study adds amino acid embeddings from a pretrained protein language model to mRNA-derived features. A nanopore approach classifies E. coli tRNA species from direct RNA ionic currents without basecalling, reporting 98.2% accuracy. OligoFragger applies spectrum graphs to constrain modified-oligonucleotide MS/MS searches with FDR control. BIOREDIS integrates nine resources for end-to-end nucleic acid therapeutic design, including codon optimization and shRNA/siRNA design. The new contributions are feature enrichment, benchmarking, signal-level classification and workflow integration; the items do not report head-to-head comparisons across these tools.
